tasks.subject: Task 1: Formatting helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure functions that turn row facts into text cells (humanDuration, reviewFacts, authorLabel, cleanTitle), with every spec rule tested.

**Files:**
- Modify: render.go
- Test: render_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- humanDuration returns <1h, Nh, Nd, Nmo, Ny with boundaries 59m, 1h, 23h, 24h, 89d, 90d, 364d, 365d and clamps negatives
- reviewFacts returns - for none, orders approvals, changes requested, pending requests, appends (CODEOWNERS only) only when all pending are CODEOWNERS
- authorLabel: login, login[bot], ghost for nil, 24 rune cap
- cleanTitle: control chars become spaces, 60 rune cap with ellipsis

**Verify:** go test ./... -run 'HumanDuration|ReviewFacts|AuthorLabel|CleanTitle' -v -> PASS

**Steps:** See plan Task 1 (tests first, implement, lint, commit).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["render.go", "render_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./... -run 'HumanDuration|ReviewFacts|AuthorLabel|CleanTitle' -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["humanDuration boundaries", "reviewFacts text", "authorLabel", "cleanTitle"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Row sections in the summary
tasks.description:
**Goal:** writeSummary appends capped non-draft and draft row sections; hand-written golden shows them.

**Files:**
- Modify: render.go, render_test.go, main.go (call site), testdata/report.golden.txt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Non-draft section before draft, oldest first, Review facts column only for non-draft
- Header forms: (showing N of T, ...), (T, ...), (none)
- Links line once under first section with rows; absent with no rows or unrecognised URL
- Limit 0 shows all; no trailing whitespace; old 'not in this report yet' line removed
- Golden matches byte for byte

**Verify:** go test ./... -v -> PASS incl. TestRunWithoutJSONWritesSummaryToStdout

**Steps:** See plan Task 2.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["render.go", "render_test.go", "main.go", "testdata/report.golden.txt"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["section order and sort", "header forms", "links line", "limit 0", "no trailing whitespace", "golden matches"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: --limit and --all flags
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Users can change rows per section; invalid combinations fail before any request.

**Files:**
- Modify: main.go
- Test: main_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Default 20 rows per section; --limit N; --all
- --limit 0, --limit -1, explicit --limit with --all exit 2 with usage, no request, with or without --json
- --json with valid flags still writes full JSON
- Usage says the flags only change what the terminal shows

**Verify:** go test ./... -run 'Limit|All|RowFlags|TwentyRows' -v -> PASS

**Steps:** See plan Task 3.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["main.go", "main_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["default 20", "limit and all", "validation before fetch", "json unaffected", "usage text"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Documentation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Product, architecture and README describe the rows; the open decision is closed.

**Files:**
- Modify: docs/product.md, docs/architecture.md, README.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- No doc still says rows are only in the JSON
- product.md section 6 records the decision (2026-10-06) and defines humanized times, approvals wording, sample-not-trace
- README example equals testdata/report.golden.txt

**Verify:** diff <(sed -n '/^Repository  acme/,/^```$/p' README.md | sed '$d') testdata/report.golden.txt && echo same -> same

**Steps:** See plan Task 4.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/product.md", "docs/architecture.md", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./... && golangci-lint run", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no stale statements", "decision recorded", "README example equals golden"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Check against real output
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Look at rows on a real public repository and report anything misleading.

**Files:** none unless a defect is found.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Built binary prints both sections for a real repo with visible truncation
- Three rows match GitHub
- Long titles/logins, bots, non-ASCII were checked; findings reported

**Verify:** go build -o gh-pramen . && ./gh-pramen -R dlvhdr/gh-dash -> summary plus rows, exit 0

**Steps:** See plan Task 5. Ask the user before pushing or opening the PR.
